Release 2 / Serial number 170127 / Inform v6.34 Library 6/11 S

Input Room
This is an input room. A sign reads, "GET any of these inputs to test it." Below the sign is a story-window button (lit) and a status-window button.

You can see a character input, a unicode character input, a line input, a unicode line input and a timer input here.

>Enter character:
>>
Got character (dec) 103, (hex) $67: g

>Enter line:
>>Got 14 characters:
s o m e <space> t e s t <space> l i n e 
Hex: $73 $6F $6D $65 $20 $74 $65 $73 $74 $20 $6C $69 $6E $65 

>This button lets you test input in the story window (the default).

>This button lets you test input in the status window.
